name: 自动思考档位
description: 为 agent 提供 get_thinking_level 与 set_thinking_level 两个工具：按任务形态主动调整思考等级——歧义、调试、高风险改动、多步综合时升档，例行琐碎操作保持低档（ADR 0257）。

en.name: Adaptive Thinking
en.description: Gives the agent get_thinking_level and set_thinking_level tools so it can adapt the thinking level to the task shape: raise it for ambiguity, debugging, risky changes, or multi-step synthesis; keep it low for routine trivial operations (ADR 0257).
